fact: On 27 April 2025 the Ministry of Education and Reform of the Education System sent field missions from Nouakchott to train the sector's regional officials on the Siraj system and to update and collect the incomplete data of educational establishments; the minister said the platform works without internet over the ordinary telephone network and that parents would soon be given access to it.
title: وزارة التربية تطلق بعثات تكوينية لاستخدام نظام "سراج"
